en: Ugh... I had no idea it would be\nthis cold... I can't go on...
Rena, stay strong! Our\nparadise should be just beyond\nthis blizzard!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision; prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Evelysse: "

en: You're right, Evelysse. Just a little\nfurther... Yes, once we cross\nthat mountain...
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Ri-tan, Rena-tan, you're both\nway too careless, dressing like\nthat for a snowy mountain.

But Coro told us the resupply
point was a town where we
could enjoy natural hot
springs... I never imagined it
would be surrounded by snowy
mountains like this.

Honestly, Coro is
unbelievable! I know we have to
avoid being noticed by the
locals, but he didn't have to
warp us down into the middle
of the mountains!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision; prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Evelysse: "

en:
Once we reach the town, Lymle
will make you some warm
coats, so just hang in there
until then.
That's right. Lymle, like me,\ncomes from a region with\nheavy snowfall.

Evelysse, Rena, snowy lands are
wonderful. It's precisely
because of this harsh
environment that one develops
a strong heart that isn't easily
shaken―just like her.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Exactly. "Old-tan" actually says\nsomething useful once in a\nwhile.
What are you so surprised\nabout? That's what Riri-tan\nalways calls you.

Ugh... I-I see, Relia... If that's
how she calls me, then I
suppose I have no choice...
Gah!!

T-there is no need for concern,
Captain. I am a man forged in
the snowlands. I cannot let
myself be shaken by this... Grrr!

Huh? Come to think of it,
Lymle, where did Cerberus go?
He was right here a moment
ago...
I sent him to scout the path to\ntown. It would be terrible if we\ngot lost in the snow.
Hm? Speak of the devil... It\nlooks like Cerberus is back.
Wait... is someone riding on his\nback?
It looks like a young boy...? Did\nCerberus kidnap someone?!
Hmph. He would never do such\na thing.

Besides, that boy is wearing so
little for these snowy
mountains; he looks like he's
about to freeze!
We're heeeere! Phew,\nyou're seriously amazing!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Boy: "

en: Bark!
Cerberus, who is this child?

Hehe, is this your dog?
Sorry, I borrowed him for a bit!
I was heading down the snowy
mountain alone and spotted a
dog that looked like he'd be
fun to hang out with.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Boy: "

en: Wait, you were out here in the\nsnow all by yourself? Are you\nokay!?

What do you mean,
"okay"? ...Ah! I didn't get thrown
off or anything! I was riding him
perfectly, right!?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Boy: "

en: No, that's not what I meant...
More importantly, this dog!\nHe's so cool! And he's a great\nride!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Boy: "

en: Wahaha! Stop licking me\nall of a sudden! That tickles!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Boy: "

en:
Running around in the snow
wearing so little... Children from
snowy regions really are
tough...
No, even in my homeland, a\nchild like this would be rare...
Plus, his mental strength is\namazing; he's not intimidated\nby Cerberus at all.
It's also rare for Cerberus to\ntake a liking to someone so\nquickly.
It is strange, but...

Right now, the most important
thing is getting this boy to
safety! Let's take him to town
first! He'll freeze if he stays on
this snowy mountain!
Hey, what's your name?
Frost: <font color=yellow>Frost</font>. Why?
I'm Rena. Frost, you'll freeze to\ndeath if you stay out here.
I'll be fine. I'm actually pretty\ngood with the cold.
Even so! We're heading to\ntown. Come with us.
Huh? You're heading to town,\nbut you're stuck out here in\nthe snowy mountains?

Hahaha, I get it. You're lost,
aren't you? Walking around
way off the main road... that's
dangerous.
What?
I guess I have no choice. I'll\nguide you lost little ladies. Just\nfollow me.
Hmm, somehow it feels like\nwe're the ones being rescued\nnow.
A-anyway! This way we can get\nFrost to town too. It's like\nkilling two birds with one stone!

What are you doing? This is
exactly why you get
lost―standing around
daydreaming!
Hey, wait up! Don't just run\nahead, let's go together!

Finally, a town! A real,
honest-to-goodness town! Now,
where are those hot springs
I've been dreaming of?!

What's this? You lot
actually thought this was still a
hot spring resort? Those dried
up five years ago.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Townman: "

en:
Tough luck. All that's
left here are bathtubs buried in
snow and souvenirs that
nobody wants to buy.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Townman: "

en:
No... does that mean Coro gave
us fake information about the
hot spring town...? And we
walked all the way through the
snowy mountains for nothing...

Stay strong, Evelysse! It's a shame,
but we did manage to get
Frost to town. Let's focus on
finding Frost's family.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
You're right! Once we find
Frost's family, I'm going to
make Coro find the best hot
spring in this entire star
system!
But Fu-tan's wandered off\nsomewhere, you know?
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision; agent (en-prefix 2026-10-08, english.md 7.21): ふーたん is the nickname for Frost (Fu-tan, as D026_030_38, D026_050_28, D026_060_25); the engine read it as an address to Evelysse (was "But, Evelysse. Frost is gone."); needs a person's review

en: Huh? You're right! Where did\nyou go, Frost?!
Hmm, look there, behind that\nshop! Isn't that Frost?

...Eh? Frost, what are you
doing?! If you pull that cloth
from under the pile of
merchandise...!
Everything in the shop went\nboom.
Oh no! We have to help clean\nthis up!
Wh-who is it?! Who did this to\nmy merchandise?!
Aw man, I thought I could pull\nthe cloth out just like a magic\ntrick.
You... don't tell me!
It's Frost! The snow monster,\nFrost, is back!! Everyone, catch\nhim this time!
Catch me if you can, you\nlosers!
What's going on? A snow\nmonster...?

Regardless, we must capture
Frost! We cannot allow him to
escape after committing such
a misdeed!
Hehe, I'm not stupid enough to\nget caught by a lost little\nbrother!
Alright, this shelf is all finished!
Sorry about this, girls. I really\nappreciate you helping me\nreorganize the merchandise...
Not at all, we're happy to help.\nI'm just glad none of the items\nwere damaged when they fell.
Whoa! Dad, what\nhappened?! The shop is a total\nmess!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Young Man: "

en:
<font color=yellow>Jack</font>! I didn't do this! It was
Frost, that snow monster
Frost! I can't believe we got hit
two years in a row...
Huh... Frost...
Jack. Sorry, but could you\nhandle organizing the shelves\non the right?
Yeah, got it.
You mentioned two years in a\nrow―did something like this\nhappen last year too?
It happens every year. I reckon\nevery single shop on this main\nstreet falls victim to its pranks.
Oh, Captain, welcome back. It\nlooks like you weren't able to\ncatch Frost.

My apologies. We cornered it
near the town entrance, but a
sudden blizzard broke out and
it managed to escape.
The mountains are a complete\nwhiteout; it's too dangerous to\npursue him.

Aye, I figured as much when
the wind picked up. That's a
classic move for Frost, the
snow monster. He can
manipulate the weather, you
see.
So that sudden blizzard was\nFrost's doing as well.
What do you mean, "snow\nmonster Frost"? Who exactly is\nFrost?

He's a monster that's been
appearing only during the
snowy season for about ten
years now, playing prank after
prank. He pulls some flashy
stunt, and the moment he's
spotted, he kicks up a blizzard
and flees back to the snowy
mountains.
See that broken fountain over\nin the park? They say Frost is\nthe one who broke that, too.

I see. It's such a shame for the
fountain in the center of town
to stay broken; it makes the
place feel so melancholy.

I'd love to fix it, but since the
hot springs dried up, this town
has neither the funds nor the
materials to repair it.
This is a grave situation. We\nmust capture Frost and reason\nwith him immediately...!

The Captain is right.
Regardless of the snowy
season, once it gets warmer,
wouldn't we be able to catch
Frost even if he tries to start
a blizzard?

That's the thing. For some
reason, once the snow starts
to melt, we completely forget
what that monster even looked
like.
And I mean every single\nresident of this town, all at\nonce.
What do you mean by that?
I reckon that's just another\none of those snow monster's\nmysterious tricks.

Once the snow melts, not only
do we forget what the monster
looks like, but all sorts of
memories about it just vanish.
Just like the snow melting
away.

Being told to search the
mountains for someone whose
appearance we can't even
recall... that is certainly an
impossible task.

But if you've completely
forgotten, how do you
remember that you were a
victim last year too,
Shopkeeper?
Ah. That's because of this.
What is it, a piece of paper?\n"The Snow Monster, Frost, has\narrived"...?

For the past few years, it's
been leaving traces behind at
the shops it targets. It left the
same piece of paper last year.
To go out of its way to leave\nsomething like this... it's almost\nas if it wants to be caught.
But Fu-tan always runs away\ninto the snow so they can't\ncatch them!
And that's why I've been a\nvictim of these pranks year\nafter year.
Pops, I'm finished cleaning up\nover here.

Oh, I'm all done over here too.
You folks were a huge help. I
think I can finally reopen the
shop!
Ah, Captain! I'm sorry, I zoned\nout during our resupply\nmission.
Yeah, I was thinking about\nFrost...

When we met in the snowy
mountains, she didn't seem like
the kind of girl who would keep
playing pranks and causing
trouble for everyone.
I just wonder why Frost is\ndoing this...

Go see Frost? Captain! You're
going to look for her in this
snow!? I know the blizzard is
awful, but we don't even know
where she is...
Sniff sniff! With Wan-wai\naround, that'll be a piece of\ncake!
Bow!

I believe that those who
commit misdeeds must be held
accountable. They cannot be
allowed to keep running away.
In that case, we have one goal.\nLet's go find Frost!
Um, are you going to look for\nFrost? If it's alright, I'd like to...
Hm? Oh, you're Jack, the\nshopkeeper's son, right?

I understand your anger over
the prank played on your shop,
but the snowy mountains are
dangerous. Please wait here.
Just leave it to Lym and the\nothers!
Found you, Frost!
What!? How did you guys find\nme here!? I'm sure I shook you\noff in the blizzard!
It was the power of Doggie\nBite. Hehe!
...You tracked my scent, huh?\nTsk, I should've made it snow\neven harder.
Still, this is quite a cave.\nLooking at the construction, I\nwonder if it's man-made?

It's a cave the townspeople are
digging to try and bring back
the dried-up hot springs. Of
course, nobody comes here
during this season.

They haven't reached the
springs yet, but if I listen to
the voice of the earth, I can
definitely feel a water vein
nearby.

I hate seeing everyone in town
looking so gloomy because the
springs dried up, so I figured I'd
just dig through the rest
myself!
Digging through? How are you\ndoing that alone, without any\ntools?
Heheh! Around here, it's a\ngiven that snow monsters are\nthe strongest!

Now, Frost. Don't you want to
get along with everyone in
town? You're even digging for
the hot springs to help the
town recover...

If you want to be friends, you
can't be playing pranks! Let's
go back and apologize! And we
can help fix the things you
broke...
...That won't work. If I do that,\nno one will ever remember me.
Huh? What do you mean?

When the snow melts, it ain't
just the monster's form that
vanishes―all the memories of it
disappear too. Just like the
snow melting away.
...Exactly. Once the snow melts,\neveryone in town completely\nforgets about me.

Snow monsters fall asleep
when the snowy season ends,
and stay that way until the
next one.
It's a real shock. I wake up, go\ninto town, and not a single\nperson remembers who I am...
So, the reason people can't\nremember Frost isn't because\nof a spell he used to escape.
Why would I use a spell to\nmake everyone forget me?\n...This is more like a curse.

But I guess since I'm a snow
monster―since I'm the snow
itself―I just melt away from
everyone's memories along with
the snow...

Even if they forget, you can
just introduce yourself all over
again. Then you can become
friends once more...

I've already tried that!! Over
and over and over...!! ...But
everyone still forgets. Not one
person remembers...
Frost...
But a few years ago, something\namazing happened.

That year, I was playing tag in
the park with a kid I'd become
friends with. But I got a little
too carried away while chasing
them and ended up breaking
the fountain.

To destroy a stone fountain
like that... as you mentioned,
you possess considerable
strength.

Hey, I am a monster, after all!
Anyway, the crash was so loud
that everyone started freaking
out, so I just bolted.

I figured once winter ended,
everyone would just forget who
did it, right along with the
snow.

But I was wrong. They didn't
remember my face, but last
winter, there were rumors
about some brat who'd broken
the fountain!

Bad news travels fast, does it?
It may be true that misdeeds
spread more easily than good
deeds.

The townspeople, who had
completely forgotten me no
matter how close we'd become,
actually remembered what I
did!
So you're saying you've been\nplaying pranks in conspicuous\nplaces on purpose?

Exactly! That shopkeeper
remembered how I knocked
over the merchandise the
same way last year, right? He
hadn't forgotten me!
You can't do it this way!\nEveryone is just going to end\nup hating you, Frost!
...What's so bad about being\nhated?
What? But... wouldn't it be\npainful to be hated?
Being forgotten is way more\npainful than being hated.

Do you guys get it? A kid I've
become friends with wakes up,
and then they look at me like
I'm some total stranger.

Even so, I try my best to
befriend them again, year after
year, calling out to them... but
then they just grow up and
stop playing with me.
And eventually, they forget\nabout me forever...
Frost...

Anyway, aren't you guys here
to catch me? I don't mind
getting caught, but be careful
of the blizzard until you reach
town.
Look, I can hear the wind\npicking up...
What is it?
There's the sound of beasts\nmixed in with the wind...? And\nthat... that's a human voice!!

A human voice...? Hmm,
someone might be under
attack by beasts on the
mountain path! Let us continue
the pursuit of Frost!

Oh no! Someone from town is
being attacked by a beast!! I
think that's Jack, the
shopkeeper's son!
You stay hidden somewhere\nsafe!
Ugh... sorry about this... You be\ncareful too!! Frost...!
Huh... did he just... say my\nname...?
Don't let your guard down with\nthe enemy right in front of you,\nFrost! Here it comes!!
Phew, I think we managed to\ndrive those beasts away.

Hmm, they seem a bit different
from the herds that usually
come through here every year.
It looks like they've been driven
from their habitat and have
become aggressive... the town
might be in danger.
I need to find a way to tell the\ntown guard before the herd\ncomes back...
Frost... I really don't think\nplaying pranks is the right way.
That again? I already told you.\nIf you want to turn me in, go\nahead.

That's not it! I just think it's
wrong for someone who cares
about this town as much as
you do, Frost, to be
misunderstood like this.
Then what do you want me to\ndo?! If there were any other\nway, I wouldn't be doing this!
...I'd rather be hated and\nremembered than be forgotten\nforever...!
I remember, Frost!!

Twelve years ago, remember
how we secretly doodled on
the shop pillars so your old
man wouldn't find out? He still
hasn't noticed those drawings.

What, Jack... why do you
remember that? I mean, the
snow has melted so many
times since then...
No matter how forgetful I am,\nI'll never forget a precious\nfriend. Not you, Frost.

I mean, I wanted to sound cool,
but sorry―I actually forgot all
about it for the last twelve
years. At least until I saw that
graffiti on the pillar...

You remembered just by
seeing some graffiti? No one
else ever remembered me,
even when they were shown
things from our past!

Yeah, the graffiti alone didn't
bring it back right away. It just
left me feeling restless, like
there was something on the tip
of my tongue. So I looked for
something that might help.
And then I found this.
This is... um, what is it? It looks\nlike a swarm of earthworms\ncrawling around...
This is a picture diary from our\nwinter break homework!
Your handwriting and drawings\nare hideous...

Still as foul-mouthed as ever,
huh? But looking at this is
what made me remember your
face.
Honestly, it hurts that this is\nwhat reminded you of me.
Haha, fair enough. But I wonder\nwhy? It all came back so\nclearly.
I see, this must be it! Frost's\npower isn't actually erasing the\nmemories people have of him!

They're just buried deep in the
back of their minds. As long as
there's a trigger, everyone can
remember Frost.
That's why those weird\ndrawings helped me remember\nFu-tan!
Exactly. Snow melts into water\nor vapor, but it doesn't actually\nvanish.

It's the same with the
memories of Frost. They never
disappeared; they were always
there in Jack's heart.

I suppose it's the same for the
townspeople. That broken
fountain acted as a small
trigger to bring back their
memories of Frost.

Right! So if we provide the
townspeople with something to
help them remember Frost
clearly, they'll be able to keep
those memories without any
more pranks!

Hmm, now that we know how,
the rest is simple. First, you
must apologize for your past
actions in town, make amends,
and become friends with
everyone once again.
First, regarding that fountain...
I came all this way because I\nabsolutely had to apologize to\nyou about that fountain!
The fountain?
Y-you! That's...!

To be honest, I was the one
who broke the park fountain
first. I snapped a screw, and
water started spraying out of a
weird spot...

Frost tried to take the blame
for me by breaking it even
more spectacularly to cover up
what I'd done.
At the time, I just thought\neveryone would forget about it\nonce winter was over.

While I was agonizing over
when to tell the townspeople
the truth, the snow melted and
I ended up forgetting I'd done
it too...

I'm the worst, aren't I? Letting
my friend take all the blame
and then just forgetting about
it.
No, that's just the power of my\nsnow monster. You didn't do\nanything, Jack...!

I'm going to tell everyone in
town this time. I'm turning 18
this year. Even if they tell me
to pay for the repairs, I'll find
some way to make the money...
Hm? What is this shaking!?
!! I can hear those beasts in\nthe wind!! There are twice as\nmany as before!!
Over there! I see them! There's\na huge one too!!
What the hell is that!? I've\nnever seen beasts like that\naround here!!
Jack!! Get back to town and\nwarn the guards! I'll handle\nthings here!!
...Right, got it! Don't do\nanything reckless, Frost!!
Everyone, let's make sure we\nprotect the town Frost loves\nso much!!
I won't let you destroy this\ntown!! Raaaaaaaah!!

His strength is beyond what I
imagined... I shouldn't have
underestimated a snow
monster.
Heh, that's just how I roll!
We drove away quite a few\nbeasts, so the town should be\nsafe now.
Hmph, but the ground is still all\nwobbly and shaky.

What is this shaking!? It
doesn't feel like an enemy is
approaching; it feels like it's
coming from deep
underground...

We are truly
grateful. Not only did you
protect our town, but you even
found the hot spring vein...
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Town Elder: "

en:
Now we can
rebuild this desolate place into
a hot spring resort once again!
I don't know how to thank you
enough...
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Town Elder: "

en:
It wasn't us who found the
vein, it was Frost. He also
played a huge part in the fight
to protect the town.
F-Frost...? You\nmean that snow monster,\nFrost!?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Townspeople: "

en:
The hot spring
was dug up by that brat
Frost!? I hope nothing weird
happens...
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Townspeople: "

en:
Everyone! If you're going to
thank us for what we've done,
please give Frost a chance to
speak!
Hm!? Is this brat\nthat Frost!?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Village Elder: "

en: That little menace!\nHe tore up my shop! I'm gonna\nget him!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Villagers: "

en: Everyone, please! Just listen to\nhim...!
Don't worry, sis. I know I've\ngotta take responsibility for\nwhat I've done.

To everyone in town... I'm sorry
for all the trouble I've caused
over the years. I apologize for
everything.
Oh, thank goodness! Everyone\nactually accepted Frost...

It helped that Frost
remembered everyone he
played pranks on and
apologized so sincerely.

Additionally, the fact that he
had been protecting the town
from beasts in secret for so
long...

...and that he had been
searching for the water vein
since the hot springs dried up
five years ago likely played a
large part.
Everyone could tell how much\nFu-tan loves this town.

However, this does not mean
you are completely off the
hook. You understand that,
Frost?
You don't have to spell it out\nfor me, "old man."
Old man...!?
Frost... not you too...

Helping out the shops I
pranked, patrolling the
outskirts, and searching for
new water veins―though only
during the snowy season. My
head is spinning just thinking
about it.
And don't forget about fixing\nthe fountain! I'll help you out,\nso let's give it our best!
That too... Honestly, I don't\neven know where to start\nanymore.

Why don't we make a schedule
for your chores? If we give
copies to the townspeople, no
one will forget about you,
Frost.
Which also means you won't be\nallowed to slack off~.
If you want, I can make it with\nsome portraits!
Jack's portraits don't look like\nanyone. Drawing is Lymle's job!
Hey! Jack! Should I\njust leave this sign here?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Town Man: "

en: Yeah, that's fine. Thanks!
Hm? What sign? Let's see...\n"Frost Spring"?

I've never heard of a hot spring
discovered by a snow monster
before. That's why I'm planning
to use that as a selling point
to attract tourists.
Hey, don't just go using my\nname without my permission!\nI'm charging you a royalty fee!
Fine, but that fee will go\nstraight toward the materials\nfor repairing the fountain.
Gah...
I think that's a wonderful idea.\nIt'll bring more life to the town,

And more than anything, it'll
leave reminders of Frost all
over the city for everyone to
remember him by.

Frost really is like snow. Just
as snow melts and turns into
steam, he'll continue to play a
part in this town in many
different ways.

This story has come to an end.
More stories will be released in
the future. Please look forward
to them.
Alright, this time for sure...
Claude, stop!! You can't just\ndraw your weapon in a place\nlike this!!
Waaaaah!! Rena! You scared\nme...
I'm the one who's scared!\nThat's dangerous! Put your\nweapon away, now!
Hahaha, little lady,\nis this your first time at a\nshooting gallery?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Shopkeeper: "

en: Eh? A shooting gallery?

It's a game. You use this gun
to fire cork bullets and knock
down the targets on those
shelves over there.

Oh, I didn't know they had
games like that. But Claude,
you're trained with guns as a
soldier, right? Shouldn't this be
easy for you?

Easy, huh? Tell
you what, why don't you give it
a try, little lady? I'll give you
one shot for free!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Shopkeeper: "

en: Really? Thank you very much.
So I aim for those targets from\nhere. Alright, steady...
I did it! A hit, right in the\ncenter!
...Huh? I hit it, but it's wobbling\nwithout falling...

So close, little lady! Just hitting
the box on your first try shows
real talent. How about another
round?
It's frustrating that it didn't fall.\nI'll try again!
Alright, I'm not giving up yet\neither! Mister, one more round!
Hehe, thanks for the business!
Ugh, we both failed miserably...
Dammit... I'm hitting them, but\nstill. I'm almost out of spare\nchange. This is my last shot...
Claude. Would you be\ninterested in betting that last\nshot on me?
Henri! How long have you been\nthere?!
My apologies. You were both\nso absorbed that I missed my\nchance to speak up.
So, what will it be? That last\nshot?
Amazing! The box actually fell!

I just did exactly what Henri
suggested, but I can't believe I
actually knocked the box down
in one shot...
Henri! How do you do it? How\ncan you knock the boxes down\nlike that?
It's quite simple. You just have\nto follow the laws of physics to\nderive the optimal solution.
The laws of physics?

Yes. First, the gun. Since there
seem to be differences in the
strength of the springs that
launch the corks, you should
choose the newest gun
available.

Next is the orientation of the
cork. Loading it with the
pointed end facing the target
reduces the surface area upon
impact, which increases the
force.
I see, I see.

Then, fix your gaze on the
target, but instead of the
center, aim for the upper right
edge.
What? Why? You have to aim\nfor the center!

We aren't fighting an enemy
here. We're simply knocking
over a stationary box. In that
case, by aiming as far from the
center of gravity as possible...
Oh! That would throw off the\nbalance and make it spin! That\nwould make it fall over easily!
What?!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Stall Owner: "

en: Oh, I see. His explanation is\nlogical and very easy to\nunderstand!
I did it! I followed what that guy\nsaid and I actually got one!
I'm going again! I'm definitely\nknocking one down this time!
Alright, time for my revenge!

No way in hell!! I
can't have you spreading that
kind of talk in front of my
shop! You three are banned!
Now get out!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Shopkeeper: "

en: Waaaaah!!
Too bad, looks like we can't go\nnear the shooting gallery\nanymore.
M-my apologies. This is all my\nfault...
No, we still got to keep the last\nprize we won. Thanks for the\nadvice.

I'm glad you feel that way. Now,
I'd rather not be glared at by
the shopkeeper any longer, so I
shall return to the ship for a
while.
Farewell, Claude. I wish you the\nbest of luck.
Wait, Henri!!
...I can't believe Henri saw right\nthrough me...
...? What do you mean, "saw\nthrough you"?
Uh... Rena, this... well. Would\nyou like to have it?

This is the prize you were
aiming for at the shooting
gallery, isn't it, Claude? Are
you sure I can have it?
Open it and see.

I heard it's an accessory made
from a special ore found
around here. I thought it would
look great on you, Rena.

Oh, but maybe you don't like
prizes from shooting galleries?
There was a jewelry shop over
there, so maybe I should have
gone to a proper store...!

No! I love it! The design is so
delicate and beautiful! You
have great taste in
accessories, Claude!
How... does it look? Does it suit\nme?
Yeah, it looks great on you.
Thank you so much, Claude. I'll\ntreasure it.

I only applied because it
sounded like a bit of fun, but
there are quite a few
participants. The "Hot Spring
Table Tennis Tournament"...

Yeah, if it's doubles with the
Captain, I don't feel like we can
lose to anyone. Alright, let's
aim for the championship!

Now
hold on, you can't use that
racket! Please read the
tournament guidelines carefully.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Tournament Organizer: "

en: Huh? This isn't a normal table\ntennis tournament?

Let's see... according to the
guidelines, "The racket to be
used will be determined by a
lottery on the day of the
event!"

Wait, are we supposed to use
those washbasins or coffee
milk bottles in the back as
rackets? That's way too
difficult!

Now,
now, everyone is doing their
best to get creative. Come on,
please draw your lot!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Tournament Organizer: "

en: Well, I guess those are the\nrules. It can't be helped. ...Okay,\nI'll take this one!!

Oh,
here is the item written on
your lot. Use this as your
racket and do your best in the
tournament!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Tournament Organizer: "

en: What... a slipper?
First round, here we go! Sarah,\nlet's do this, myah!
I'm ready, Meri!
What, the two of them are in\nthis too!?
I won't lose, even against\n<player> and Evelysse!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Fuwaaa! The "Hairdryer Racket"\ncord is wrapping all around my\nbody!
Myamyam!! Sarah's cord is\ncoming this way too!!

Alright, first round cleared! I
was worried about what would
happen if the Slipper Racket
hit something, but it has a
handle, so it's actually pretty
easy!
(...But my arm feels a bit\nstrange. Am I out of shape?\nNo, that can't be it...)
No, it's nothing. I'll keep this\nmomentum going and win it all!

Alright! Next up is the
semifinals, Eu! That gorgeous
grand prize is practically within
our reach!
Well, it would be frustrating to\nlose after coming this far! Let's\ndo this, Welch!
...Um, aren't there a bit too\nmany of our friends in this\ntournament?

Still, it doesn't matter who
shows up, I'm going to win!
There's no way I'll lose to
something as heavy-looking as
a "Wok Racket"!

Hehehe, you're naive, Evelysse! I'm a
blacksmith! I've been swinging a
hammer every single day for
years! I'll show you I can handle
a wok!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Ugh... I can't imagine continuing\nto swing a wok for a full set...
If only we'd finished the match\nsooner...
*Pant, pant*... That semi-final\nwas definitely a brutal fight.
(Urgh... my arm still feels off...)

What? You're telling me to
stop smashing? Why? I can't
win unless I go on the
offensive!

Ah, I see. True, that Slipper
Racket is too soft, so you can't
really put any power into the
ball.

And because you're forcing
yourself to hit fast shots
despite that, it seems like it's
putting a huge strain on Evelysse's
arm.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
You're saying I should switch to
a strategy of just defending
and waiting for the opponent
to mess up...

It's true that everyone is using
weird rackets, so the chance
of a mistake is high. But with
that strategy...

Now,
the moment you've all been
waiting for―the finals!! Finalists,
please step forward!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Tournament Organizer: "

en: Um, Victor... I just wanted the\nparticipation prize snack set as\na souvenir for Miki and Relia...

Why are you being so timid!
Now that we've come this far,
desertion is not an option,
Fidel!

And by winning this
tournament, I shall prove my
youthful vigor and become a
man worthy of being called "big
brother" by Relia!

Hmm, I'm not even going to
mention that this tournament is
basically just our friends
anymore! Let's do this, Captain!

Wait, what is that?! Fidel and
Victor's rackets... are those
clothes hangers? And thin wire
ones at that!

It matters not how thin the
racket is! As long as you hit
the center of the ball, there is
no shot that cannot be
returned!
In a way, I suppose it does\nshare some similarities with\nswordsmanship.
Now, let us settle this with a\nfair fight!!

(I knew it, Fidel and Victor.
Even with those thin wire
hanger rackets, they're
returning the ball with such
precision...)

(Playing defensively to bait
them into making a mistake is
pointless against these two...
My arm is aching, but I have
to...!)
I'll go for the smash
I shouldn't overdo it
I-incredible... What a smash...
Tsk, to rotate your entire body\nalong with your arm to strike...\na clever move...
Still, I cannot back down now.\nVictory shall be ours!
This is our chance!! <player>,\nfinish it off!!!
Whoa!
So... this is where it ends...
We did it!!! <player>, we won!

A
brilliant victory! The champions
are this lovely couple! I take it
the secret to your success
was the power of love?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Tournament Organizer: "

en: Wh-what?! Where is this\ncoming from?! We aren't a\ncouple!!
Evelysse, it's hard to believe you\nwhen you're clinging to him like\nthat.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Waaaaah! I was just so happy\nwe won, I couldn't help it...!!

I-I'm going to hit the hot
springs!! I'm all sweaty and it
feels gross! U-um, you handle
the prize for me, okay?!

Evelysse certainly has a lot of
energy. Perhaps I shall
challenge her to another match
later. I won't lose next time!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: I think you have plenty of\nenergy too, Victor...
But Captain! I had to push\nmyself to the limit just to beat\nthose two...
Forfeit?! You can't be serious...\nwe're only one win away from\nvictory!
Saying my health is more\nimportant... <player>.

Since
the opposing team has
forfeited, the winning team is
Team Camus Style! And the
ultra-luxurious grand prize is...!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Tournament Organizer: "

en:
A
blessing from the majestic
volcano this hot spring town is
so proud of! The Marble Stone!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Tournament Organizer: "

en: Huh, a rock?

It looks like marble. It's quite
high quality. I think it's almost
the same material used for the
hallways in my home.

Use it
for home interior! Carve it into
a sculpture! Highest quality
Marble Stone! And this time,
we are awarding a whopping
50 tons!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Tournament Organizer: "

en: Fi... 50 tons...
Uh... Captain... do we even have\nspace for that much rock on\nthe ship...
If we have a stone that big, the\nship won't be able to fly, mya~.
L-let's politely return it...
You're right. Looking at that\nprize, I'm glad we didn't win.

Evelysse, I asked one of the staff
members, and they said the
hot springs here are great for
sore muscles. It might help with
the pain in your arms.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: I worked up quite a sweat, so\nthis is perfect!
Hehe, why don't you join me,\n<player>?
O-obviously I'm joking! Don't\nactually get flustered! Anyway,\nI'm heading in!!

*Sigh*, it's hopeless when she
gets embarrassed by her own
jokes... You've got your work
cut out for you, Captain.
